question_text: What network motifs recur across transcriptional regulatory networks, and what dynamic behaviour does each motif produce?
cutoff_rationale: 1-point percentile title-sampling from p15 to p50 (decile bands were smooth, no visible cliff -- same as every question so far, not sufficient on its own). Off-topic content (immune-system networks, disease networks, protein-domain networks, physiological networks) starts appearing as early as p21, but genuine bacterial-regulatory-network content (FNR, Fur, MalT, ArcA-P regulons; Boolean-network dynamics; feed-forward loops) dominates again through p35 (score 0.3971), then trends off-topic from p36 (score 0.3944) onward. Cutoff set at that p35/p36 transition.
